name: kind: jobright job info URL
spec_quote: **kind(url)** → "jobright" for `jobright.ai/jobs/info/…`

name: kind: handshake URL
spec_quote: "handshake" for any `joinhandshake.com` URL

name: kind: linkedin jobs view
spec_quote: "linkedin" for `linkedin.com/jobs/view/…` or `linkedin.com/comm/jobs/view/…` (any case, with or without www)

name: kind: linkedin comm jobs view, mixed case, no www
spec_quote: "linkedin" for `linkedin.com/jobs/view/…` or `linkedin.com/comm/jobs/view/…` (any case, with or without www)

name: kind: linkedin company page is a near miss → null
spec_quote: anything else (a LinkedIn company page, a profile, a Greenhouse link) → null

name: kind: greenhouse link is a near miss → null
spec_quote: anything else (a LinkedIn company page, a profile, a Greenhouse link) → null

name: detect_ats: brassring host
spec_quote: brassring (`jobs.brassring.com`, `sjobs.brassring.com`, `ts.brassring.com` → that host)

name: detect_ats: jazzhr both host forms
spec_quote: jazzhr (`<x>.applytojob.com` or `app.jazz.co` → that host)

name: detect_ats: clearcompany both host forms
spec_quote: clearcompany (`apply.clearcompany.com` or `<x>.hrmdirect.com` → host)

name: detect_ats: paycom
spec_quote: paycom (`paycomonline.net` → "paycomonline.net")

name: detect_ats: rippling slug
spec_quote: rippling (`ats.rippling.com/<slug>` → slug)

name: detect_ats: breezy host lower-cased
spec_quote: breezy (`<x>.breezy.hr` → host) ... Hosts are lower-case.

name: detect_ats: recruitee and teamtailor in fixed order
spec_quote: recruitee (`<x>.recruitee.com` → host), teamtailor (`<x>.teamtailor.com` → host)

name: detect_ats: pinpoint host
spec_quote: pinpoint (`<x>.pinpointhq.com` → host)

name: detect_ats: dover apply slug
spec_quote: dover (`app.dover.com/apply/<slug>` or `app.dover.io/apply/<slug>` → slug)

name: detect_ats: ultipro n<digits> host plus first path part, lower-cased
spec_quote: ultipro also matches `n<digits>.ultipro.com/<path>` (as well as recruiting.ultipro.com / recruiting2.ultipro.com) → ident = host + "/" + first path part, lower-case.

name: detect_ats: smartrecruiters www — vendor page ignored, real slug kept and lower-cased
spec_quote: smartrecruiters also matches `www.smartrecruiters.com/<Slug>` → slug lower-case, but NOT when the first path part is one of the vendor's own pages: company, customers, resources, blog, about, platform, pricing, product, solutions, demo, legal, privacy, jobs, careers, integrations (any case), and the slug must start with a letter.

name: detect_ats: ordering — new systems come after all earlier ones
spec_quote: detect_ats also records these systems by name, after all the systems listed above, in this order: brassring ..., jazzhr ..., clearcompany ..., paycom ..., rippling ..., breezy ..., recruitee ..., teamtailor ..., pinpoint ..., dover ...

name: norm_title: removes (Multiple openings)
spec_quote: **norm_title** also removes "(Multiple openings)", "(Several positions)", "(3 roles)"

name: norm_title: removes numbered roles parenthetical, any case
spec_quote: i.e. "(" + multiple / several / a number + opening(s) / position(s) / role(s) + ")" (any case)

name: norm_title: removes (Several positions)
spec_quote: **norm_title** also removes "(Multiple openings)", "(Several positions)", "(3 roles)"

name: norm_title: trailing ' in <City>, <ST>' with final period
spec_quote: and a trailing " in <City>, <ST>" with an optional final period ("Data Scientist in Cupertino, CA." → "Data Scientist").

name: norm_title: near miss — (Multiple Teams) is not the openings/positions/roles pattern
spec_quote: i.e. "(" + multiple / several / a number + opening(s) / position(s) / role(s) + ")" (any case)

name: wd_queries: two-word title yields one query
spec_quote: first norm_title(title); then, only when that has more than three words ... its first three words joined by spaces

name: wd_queries: exactly three words — no truncation entry
spec_quote: then, only when that has more than three words (words = runs of letters / digits / & / +, punctuation dropped), its first three words joined by spaces

name: wd_queries: five words → full title then first three words
spec_quote: first norm_title(title); then, only when that has more than three words (words = runs of letters / digits / & / +, punctuation dropped), its first three words joined by spaces

name: wd_queries: abbreviation expanded before counting words
spec_quote: norm_title also expands abbreviations, whole words, any case, an optional trailing dot: Sr → senior ... **wd_queries(title)** → ... first norm_title(title); then ... its first three words joined by spaces

name: wd_queries: title that normalizes to empty produces no queries
spec_quote: No empty or duplicate entries.
